title: A home for Hacktoberfest apps
summary:
Hacktoberfest apps gained a subdomain hosting path, API requests from app origins gained verification, and an elevator acquired a more specific address.

Added a deployment workflow and app registry for hosting Hacktoberfest projects on pollinations.ai subdomains. The registry includes six apps, and CatGPT moved into the Hacktoberfest app directory.

Added Turnstile verification to the text and image API cache workers for requests from localhost and non-API pollinations.ai subdomains.

Renamed the Sirius Cybernetics elevator challenge directory and its configured subdomain without changing the app. Follow-up work kept the deployment workflow from processing the app registry as an app and moved the edit debounce to description processing.
